FAQ

Confirm before starting

How do 200Gbps+ and 10Gbps+ differ?

200Gbps+ is total network bandwidth; 10Gbps+ is an enterprise per-project capability.

Does unmetered mean unlimited speed?

No. It means traffic is not billed by accumulated GB in the project model.

Are downloaders included?

No by default. Proxy projects deliver network infrastructure.

How do we test?

Use representative targets, objects, workers, storage, and deadline.
